title: Putnami missions contract, version 1
description: Request (<operation>Input) and result (<operation>Result) documents of every missions v1 operation. Required: sync, ask, reply. Optional: status. sync is host-only: the host that runs an agent calls it, never the agent itself. Message and decision ids are bare tokens, not refs: an agent types them, and they never leave their provider. A mission is named by its repository and key, compared exactly. Lengths count characters.

id.description: A message or decision id, as the provider issued it.

optionId.description: The id of one option of a decision.

missionName.description: Names a mission. Take repository and key from the session sheet. Together they are the mission's identity, compared exactly; the title is not part of it.

repository.description: The mission's repository, in lowercase, such as 'owner/name'.

key.description: The mission's key inside its repository, such as 'issue-596'. Opaque to the contract.

title.description: One line, for display. Not part of the mission's identity.

session.description: One agent session on its host.

engine.description: The host that runs the agent, in lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

sessionState.description: ended: the host closed the session or the user quit; it carries no error and no waitUntil.

loopStage.description: The stage of the contribution loop a session's change is at. The loop runs talk, declare, show, code, check, prove, validate, merge.

sessionUsage.description: The tokens a session used, cumulative for the whole session, its subagents included.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens read neither from nor into the prompt cache.

cacheWriteTokens.description: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

cacheReadTokens.description: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

syncInput.description: What a session publishes. Its natural key is session and observedAt: a provider ignores a sync older than the last one it applied for the session.

event.description: The host event that caused the sync, for display. A provider never branches on it.

waitUntil.description: Required when state is waiting, and only then.

plan.description: Replaces the mission's plan. Absent keeps it; an empty list of steps clears it.

delivered.description: Inbox messages the host gave the agent. A repeated id counts once. A provider ignores an id it does not know or that is not the caller's. Delivering an answer moves its decision to acknowledged.

decisions.description: Decisions this session asked: sending them binds them to the session. A repeated id counts once. A provider ignores an id it does not know or that is not the caller's.

replies.description: One reply per message. A refused reply gets its own entry in the result and never refuses the sync.

stage.description: The loop stage the session's change is at. Absent keeps the stage the provider holds.

usage.description: The tokens the session used so far. Replaces the usage the provider holds; absent keeps it.

missionView.description: Always the mission the request named, whatever a sync's age. A provider that does not hold it answers its key, an empty title, an empty plan and no open decision.

plan.description: The mission's current plan: the plan that the session that published last sent. Empty when none did.

option.description: The option the owner chose, when the answer chose one.

text.description: On an answer, decision.answer is the answer and text is the provider's display of it.

decision.description: Present exactly when kind is answer.

reason.description: Present exactly when state is refused. A refused reply is final: the host drops it.

inbox.description: Messages no session received yet, oldest first. Their texts, questions and answers total at most 65536 bytes.

decisions.description: One entry for each decision the sync named that the provider holds for the caller.

replies.description: One entry per reply the sync carried.

minIntervalMs.description: The pace of routine syncs, in milliseconds. A host may sync sooner at session start, at stop and during a wait, and a provider does not refuse those syncs.

askInput.description: Asks the mission's owner to decide. The answer reaches the session as an inbox message of kind answer. The same idempotencyKey with the same mission repository and key, question, context, options, recommendation and blocks replays; the mission title is not compared.

question.description: What the owner decides, as one question.

context.description: What the owner needs to decide.

options.description: The 2 to 5 answers the owner can choose.

option.description: The id of one of the options.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you choose for this question, such as 'ask-<topic>'. Reuse it only to retry the same ask.

answer.description: Absent while the decision is open.

option.description: The option the owner chose, when the answer chose one.

replayed.description: True when the idempotency key matched a decision already recorded with the same content, so nothing was asked again.

replyInput.description: Replies to one inbox message. Its natural key is the message: the same reply again replays, another reply is a conflict.

message.description: The id shown with the owner's message in the session sheet.

replayed.description: True when the message already held this reply, so nothing was written again.

statusInput.description: Reads a mission's view and its sessions. Optional: a provider that does not offer it answers unsupported. An agent may call it.

mission.description: The mission to read. Its title is for display and changes nothing.

missionSession.description: One session of the mission, as the last sync the provider applied for it reported it.

observedAt.description: The observation time of the last sync applied for the session.

stage.description: Present when the provider holds a stage for the session.

usage.description: Present when the provider holds a usage for the session.

mission.description: The mission the request named. A provider that does not hold it answers its empty view.

sessions.description: The sessions whose last applied sync named the mission, in every state, newest observedAt first, then by engine and id. A session appears once.
